title: Embed Agent-Friendly Score badge in README
body: Hello team, I am working on a project that scores public codebases based on agent friendliness. And `pytorch` has scored 84.4 out of 100. [![Agent Friendly](https://agentfriendlycode.com/api/badge/github/pytorch/pytorch.svg)](https://agentfriendlycode.com/repo/15011) -- You can add the badge in your README to let the world know about it. You just need to copy and paste this snippet 👇 ``` [![Agent Friendly](https://agentfriendlycode.com/api/badge/github/pytorch/pytorch.svg)](https://agentfriendlycode.com/repo/15011) ``` --- https://www.agentfriendlycode.com/repo/15011
provenance: Title/body fetched via GitHub search API on 2026-10-27 and sanitised by tools/sanitize.py. Only information present when the issue was opened is used; labels, comments and outcome are NOT part of the input. Limitation: the API returns the current body, so a later edit by the author would not be visible (no edit was observed for the selected cases; verify with tools/fetch_case.py --check-edits).
